stations.title: Dunstan
stations.say: Who is missing from the round-up?

stations.title: customers
stations.text: Everyone who has ever signed up.

stations.title: Postcards
stations.text: One for every customer on the round-up.

captions: At Mallowfield Seeds, Dunstan's round-up should list every customer, and some are missing.
The query keeps every customer, then a test on the date quietly drops some again.
You show who is missing, then fix the round-up and the re-order list.
Now every customer is on the round-up, and the quiet ones get a free packet.
Same customers, same orders. Nobody is dropped for having nothing to show.
